story.description:
User Story – Travelers Profile Page
Story Title
Manage Traveler Profiles from My Account
Story ID
You can name it something like: PROFILE-TRAVELERS-US-001
User Story
As a logged-in Webook user, I want to add, view, edit, and manage traveler profiles in my account so that I can quickly use saved traveler details while booking flights or travel-related services without entering the same information every time.

url = https://webook.com/en/profile/travelers
Acceptance Criteria
AC-01 – Access Travelers Page
User can navigate to Profile → Travelers page after logging in.
Travelers page loads successfully without errors.
Page heading / traveler management section is visible.
AC-02 – View Existing Travelers
If traveler profiles already exist, the user can view the saved traveler list.
Each traveler entry displays relevant details such as:
traveler name
nationality / gender if applicable
date of birth if shown
passport / ID related fields if displayed
If no travelers are saved, an appropriate empty-state message is shown.
AC-03 – Add New Traveler
User can click Add Traveler / equivalent CTA.
Traveler form opens successfully.
User can enter mandatory traveler details.
On submitting valid data, the traveler profile is saved successfully.
Newly added traveler appears in the traveler list.
AC-04 – Mandatory Field Validation
Required traveler fields cannot be left blank.
If the user submits incomplete or invalid traveler details, proper validation messages are displayed.
Invalid formats (if applicable, such as passport number / DOB / phone-related fields if present) are rejected with user-friendly messages.
AC-05 – Edit Existing Traveler
User can open an existing traveler profile for editing.
Existing traveler details are prefilled in edit mode.
User can update editable traveler information and save changes.
Updated values are reflected correctly in the traveler list / traveler details view.
AC-06 – Delete / Remove Traveler
User can remove a saved traveler profile if delete functionality is available.
If a delete confirmation modal/dialog is present, it is displayed correctly.
On confirmation, the traveler is removed from the list.
If cancellation is selected, the traveler remains unchanged.
AC-07 – Traveler Data Persistence
Saved traveler details persist after page refresh / re-login, if supported by the system.
Changes made to traveler profiles are reflected consistently across the Travelers page.
AC-08 – Error Handling
If traveler creation / update / delete action fails due to API/server issue, a clear user-friendly error message is shown.
Page should recover gracefully without corrupting existing traveler data.
User should not see broken UI or blank screen due to action failure.
AC-09 – Accessibility & Usability
Interactive controls on the Travelers page are keyboard accessible.
Labels/placeholders are available for traveler form fields.
Focus order is logical across add/edit traveler form and list actions.
Buttons like Add, Save, Edit, Delete, Cancel are clearly visible and usable.
Scope / Functional Areas Covered
This story mainly covers:
Travelers page navigation
Traveler list / empty state
Add traveler flow
Edit traveler flow
Delete traveler flow
Field validation
Error handling
Basic accessibility / usability
Non-Functional Expectations
Travelers page should load within acceptable response time.
Save/update/delete traveler actions should complete reliably.
UI should work properly across supported devices/browsers.
Traveler data should remain secure and associated only with the logged-in user account.
